findings.area: W403-01 fix, regression of the round-3 D4 protection
findings.title: import tempfile runs before the sys.path strip: an untracked stdlib-named file in scripts/qualification/ executes and can force PASS
findings.summary: Round 4 added `import tempfile` above the code that removes the script directory from sys.path. tempfile imports random and shutil (and others) that are not yet loaded, and they are resolved from sys.path[0] = scripts/qualification/ first. A planted scripts/qualification/random.py or shutil.py therefore runs before any check, in the documented command form.
findings.reproduction: raw4/r6_tempfile_shadow.txt. Clone of dc650b8df (canonical class), documented command `python scripts/qualification/evol_x_closure_publication_preflight.py --gate formal-closure` with PYTHONPATH unset: `git status` shows only `?? scripts/qualification/random.py` (same for shutil.py); output `EVOL-X closure preflight: PASS`, exit 0, with B-4/B-5/P3 open; the marker file proves the planted module ran. Control without the file: FAIL, exit 1. At 2e0ed9c6b the strip came before any non-builtin import, so this hole is new in round 4.
findings.impact: Weakest capability tier (a new untracked file that git status itself shows) yields a complete false PASS with the documented command. The A-21 check that would flag the file runs only after the code that was already hijacked.
findings.required_correction: Put the sys.path strip (or `python -I`, or a re-exec with -I -B) before every non-builtin import, and avoid importing tempfile at all (compute the prefix from os.environ/os.getpid).

findings.title: A stdlib-named file at the repository root shadows the standard library under `python -m` or PYTHONPATH=<repo>
findings.summary: Only the script directory is stripped from sys.path. With `python -m scripts.qualification.evol_x_closure_publication_preflight` (cwd on sys.path) or PYTHONPATH=<repo root> (what tests/unit/governance/test_evol_x_real_repo_fresh_clone.py::_env sets), an untracked and ignored json.py at the repo root is imported instead of the standard library. Repo-root files are in no bound tree.
findings.reproduction: raw4/r4b_shadow_variants.txt and r4_r5_shadow_env.txt: json.py (hidden by .git/info/exclude, `git status` empty) executed in module mode and with PYTHONPATH=clone; not executed in the documented script mode without PYTHONPATH.
findings.impact: Arbitrary code before any check under a non-documented but plausible invocation; the repository's own test harness uses the exposed form.
findings.required_correction: Re-exec or start with -I/-P semantics, ignore '' and PYTHONPATH entries that resolve inside the repository, and bind top-level repository files.

findings.title: IIAC companion subprocesses still load forged bytecode
findings.summary: sys.dont_write_bytecode and sys.pycache_prefix are set only in the preflight process. _companion_errors starts verify_iiac_audit_manifest.py and verify_iiac_role_separation.py with the default settings, so a forged unchecked-hash pyc for scripts/governance/iiac_common.py runs there (and may silence their exit codes). The report statement 'no repository bytecode is read' is inaccurate for them.
findings.reproduction: raw4/r1_r3_pyc_replay.txt: marker lines from both companions, four invocations; the in-process modules ran no forged code.
findings.impact: No reachable false PASS shown: after P2 the inputs of the companion checks (manifest, schema, audited/audit-execution SHAs) are sealed, so the companions cannot be made to matter. Defence-in-depth gap only.
findings.required_correction: Export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 and PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX to subprocesses (or run them with -B -I).

findings.title: Unconsumed text can still be added to operator_decisions/ and, with an edited index, to b4_reaudit/
findings.summary: A committed file in operator_decisions/ (no index exists) and an addendum listed in an edited EVIDENCE_INDEX.json of the known b4_reaudit/ directory are accepted by Gate A. An unlisted file in b4_reaudit/ is rejected.
findings.reproduction: raw4/r7_real_chain_addenda.txt on a clone of the real chain; fixture T7 in r4_atk7.txt.
findings.impact: Descriptive channels, not read by any gate; the gate-consumed scope stays sealed.
findings.required_correction: Freeze the known directories like certification/audit or allow-list file names.

findings.title: Python-environment hooks are outside what the script can defend
findings.summary: A sitecustomize.py on PYTHONPATH that prints PASS and exits 0 forces PASS for the canonical clone (reproduced); the same holds for usercustomize, .pth files in site-packages or the project venv, and a replaced interpreter. A pre-created pyc under the predictable pycache prefix (temp dir/evolx-preflight-no-bytecode-cache/<pid>) is a theoretical variant I did not brute-force.
findings.impact: Cannot be closed inside the script; the operator must decide the boundary (see dossier section 5).
findings.required_correction: Run on a fresh clone in a clean environment with `python -I -S`-style isolation.
